summary: Phase 1 /home-experience-v3 fully validated. 22/22 UI test cases PASS: route loads with data-testid=experience-root, meta noindex present, ActNav visible on desktop (4 buttons w/ correct aria-labels + hover labels), hidden on mobile (<900px), jump to acte 3 & 4 scrolls scenes into view, Navbar/Footer/CookieConsent all correctly null on this route, all 4 actes flow (scene-1-cta → scene-2 zodiac clarity → skip → scene-3 moon card → continue → scene-4 CTA after ~18s → redirect to /inscription with intent=clarity&exp_card=moon&welcome=1), experience-skip returns to /, non-regression /experience works and has no ActNav.
critical_code_review_comments: ActNav querySelector uses `[data-testid=experience-scene-${actId}]` without quotes around the attribute value — works in practice because scene IDs are numeric, but adding quotes (`[data-testid="experience-scene-${actId}"]`) is safer/best-practice.

home_v3_started fires on every mount of HomeExperienceRoot; if the user navigates away and returns, event double-fires. Consider a sessionStorage guard if strict 'once per session' semantics are desired.
Minor: console shows THREE.Clock deprecation warning (upstream three.js), and one GPU stall ReadPixels warning — cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 /home-experience-v3 is fully green. When Phase 2 arrives (Actes V-VIII), extend ActNav actsAvailable and test dot count, plus new sections' data-testid=experience-scene-5..8. Note: scene-4-cta is a <button> (not <a>) — click triggers programmatic navigation to /inscription, verify via page.expect_navigation and inspect final URL for query params.
